query:
SELECT d.id, d.filename, d.status, d.`projectId`, t.`rawJson`
FROM documents d 
LEFT JOIN transcriptions t ON t.`documentId` = d.id
WHERE d.status IN ('reviewed', 'flagged')
LIMIT 2;
